question: Is H1's zero a detector artefact or a test-design result?

gap_bands.label: 1.3-1.6 km: shorter than the published range
1.7-3.2 km: inside the published relay-ramp range
3.3-5.0 km: longer than the published range

verdict: 1063 bridges were selected with a median gap of 31.0 px (3.1 km); only 121 (11.4 %) are short enough to be rasterisation splits, while 343 (32.3 %) fall inside the published 1.6-3.2 km relay-ramp width range. The detector is therefore finding the right kind of structure. The zero is a TEST-DESIGN result, not a detector artefact: the holdout's truth is the catalogue and a bridge is by construction in the gap between catalogue strands. Raising min_gap_px would be wasted effort; the fix is an off-catalogue evaluation arm.
source_for_range: Giddens & Faulds (2025), 50th Stanford Workshop on Geothermal Reservoir Engineering, https://pangea.stanford.edu/ERE/pdf/IGAstandard/SGW/2025/Giddens.pdf
